claim_supported: Complete descriptive frozen external evaluation only. Poor external NMAEs do not support strong external generalization or reverse the matched mechanism conclusion.
limitations: Audit uses the supplied scalar contract export rather than reopening server image/geometry assets; ROI existence and annotation provenance are exported/documented evidence.

Strict CPU state loading, 497 tensors and the 50% failure fixture are verified from evaluator source and exported CPU interface evidence; this audit did not load checkpoint tensors, import torch, execute models, or recreate the fixture.
Source selection is documented and consistently fixed across evaluator/protocol/queue. This bounded audit does not reconstruct earlier training or all historical target-viewing decisions.
Timing is recorded GPU batched throughput without warm-up exclusion. Pipeline timing excludes checkpoint loading and process start, which are included in child wall time.
